conclusions: At least two 1529 printed editions from different cities contain the three clauses archivists describe as Z additions relative to signed K.
Art15 in both prints also contains shared Eucharistic statements and preserved bodily-presence disagreement; source descriptions cannot collapse the agreement into total settlement or total conflict.
Similar readings across Zürich and Basel prove circulation across different printed editions in 1529 but do not establish a direct copy-text path from signed Z, nor timing of additions.
W2118 is a distinct, institutional catalogued Zürich print (VD16 W2118 / Vischer C162, Zwingli MvK A81,8), but its actual Article15 page remains unread due link access issues.
All original era printed page reading is separate from 16th-century signed manuscript K and Z folio collations, which remain uncompleted.
